data.text: Praise the LORD! I will give thanks to the LORD with all my heart, in the council of the upright and in the assembly.
data.titulo: Praise for the LORD’s Works and Covenant

data.text: Great are the works of the LORD, studied by all who delight in them.
His work is splendor and majesty, and his righteousness endures forever.
He has made his wonders remembered; the LORD is gracious and compassionate.
He gives food to those who fear him; he remembers his covenant forever.
He has shown his people the power of his works, giving them the inheritance of the nations.
The works of his hands are faithfulness and justice; all his precepts are trustworthy,
upheld forever and ever, established in faithfulness and uprightness.
He sent redemption to his people; he ordained his covenant forever. Holy and awesome is his name.
The fear of the LORD is the beginning of wisdom; all who practice his precepts have good understanding. His praise endures forever.
